method.name: Causal Anomaly Visual-Evidence Recurrent Binding
components: zero-initialized causal visual-belief writing into partial-CoT, full-CoT, and answer states
semantic normal-null intervention with query set equal to the normal reference
same-anchor anomaly, hard-normal, normal-null ordinal preference

preflight_amendments.amendment: normalize terminal punctuation when resolving the semantic No option
preflight_amendments.reason: MMAD AD options are serialized as Yes. and No.; the original exact string comparison rejected the first locked training pair
preflight_amendments.scope: normal-null target construction and its unit test only

graft_seed.screen_result: overall improved but AD balanced accuracy unchanged; holdout unopened

data.holdout_ad_balance: 20 normal and 20 anomaly rows per source

required: nonzero causal belief-writer gradient and update
checkpoint saved after optimizer step one

validation_gate_before_holdout.all_task_noninferiority: each task no more than 1.25 percentage points below frozen public JUDO
validation_gate_before_holdout.overall_seed_noninferiority: not below the completed GRAFT seed
validation_gate_before_holdout.overall_public_superiority: strictly greater than frozen public JUDO
validation_gate_before_holdout.ad_balanced_superiority: strictly greater than frozen public JUDO and the unchanged GRAFT seed

sequential_evaluation.on_validation_gate_failure: stop without autoregressive evaluation of the holdout
sequential_evaluation.on_validation_gate_pass: freeze the final CAVER adapter and evaluate the 1120-row holdout once

holdout_analysis.primary: paired autoregressive overall exact multiple-choice accuracy delta versus frozen public JUDO

claim_policy.confirmed_improvement: overall delta > 0, AD balanced delta > 0, bootstrap lower bound > 0, and McNemar p < 0.05
claim_policy.promising_candidate: overall delta > 0 and AD balanced delta > 0 but either inferential criterion is unmet
claim_policy.mixed_or_rejected: either overall delta <= 0 or AD balanced delta <= 0

rl_policy.reason: first test whether causal evidence binding fixes the identified representation-to-answer disconnect
rl_policy.conditional_stage4c: only after Stage 4b passes both validation primary outcomes, use process-level preference optimization without tuning on the locked holdout
